retention.cleanup_scope: Audited idle rebuildable project caches before the full acceptance pair; source, original inputs, accepted evidence, AIR generations and scratch retained

storage_reconciliation.local_cache_scope: Inactive local objects were retired; stale matching metadata was then removed before final builds
storage_reconciliation.shared_cache_scope: ELF debug-source paths attributed each candidate to this project. Running executables were excluded. The later tool pass rechecked size and modification time before retirement
storage_reconciliation.measurement_limits: Counts are logical bytes for explicit files, not a measurement of net filesystem recovery. Cache rebuilds and unrelated filesystem activity overlap; an observed larger free-space increase is not attributed to this cleanup
storage_reconciliation.validation_recovery: Stale shared-cache references caused tool startup/readiness failures; final readiness and the acceptance pair use dedicated retained tooling caches

excluded_attempts: Development and cache-retry results precede frozen final builds and are not final acceptance
The first readiness attempt failed when a linker input was absent; its exact link retry passed without source changes
A readiness resume and first runtime tool invocation found stale shared-cache executable references after cache retirement; neither is credited
All nine readiness commands and both production replays were rerun with dedicated retained tooling caches
The first fresh-suite invocation rejected missing/mismatched owned roots before any gate; that log is retained under fresh/setup-failure
Canonical-map tests exposed AIR literal names requiring explicit producer-boundary encoding; the final implementation and full suite include this correction

operational_incident.description: An attempted process-tree stop included unrelated PIDs because zero-valued membership entries were retained. The stop shell exited early; effects on unrelated jobs are unconfirmed. Subsequent stopping used one exact PID with its executable verified

limitations: Selection counts do not establish complete object emission, whole-compiler execution or self-rebuild
All original definitions are attempted; dependency coverage remains conservative
First-rejection transitions do not predict completed whole-program emission
Integer undef and poison call arguments retain their prior semantics and rejection boundaries
Observed unknown-call lists do not identify one failing argument
Layout, width, frame, block-count, ABI and register-effect admission remain enforced
Selected core objects and execution observations match; executable metadata is reviewed separately
Profiling and concurrent validation timings are not compiler-throughput comparisons

Both suites start above 20 GB; successful admission and reserve enforcement do not prove that every future workload completes from exactly 20 GB free
